_about: Cyclohexane (1) + Methyl isobutyl ketone (2): isobaric T-x-y at 100.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of cyclohexane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of cyclohexane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Marrufo, B.[Beatriz], Loras, S.[Sonia], Sanchotello, M.[Margarita], Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Binary and Ternary Mixtures with Cyclohexane, Cyclohexene, and Methyl Isobutyl Ketone at 100 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 55 (2010) 5812-5817
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10, 11. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0038. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
